newsitem.title: CHINA: China summer grain harvest a record 114.1 mln T.
newsitem.headline: China summer grain harvest a record 114.1 mln T.

text.p: China's summer grain harvest this year reached a record 114.1 million tonnes, up 7.2 million tonnes from 1995, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
The rise was due to a 660,000 hectares increase in land under grain, Xinhua quoted Chen Jinhua, minister of the cabinet's State Planning Commission, as saying.
Farmland under early rice increased by 77,300 hectares this year, Chen said but gave no details for other kinds of grain.
"With increased investment in the farming sector, and higher (state) purchasing prices for grain, farmers have shown a greater initiative for growing grain crops," Xinhua quoted Chen as saying.

However, heavy rains and flooding in the major rice producing provinces of Hunan and Hubei in central China had hit early rice output, Chen said, adding that early rice output was expected to match or slightly exceed last year's level.
The total 1996 grain harvest would exceed last year's if there were no serious natural disasters for the rest of the year, he said.
China produced 465 million tonnes of grain in 1995.
